history.sg_progress: The Office of Information and Communications Technology is continuing its outreach to entities and stakeholders to implement the remaining elements of the seven-point information security action plan. Implementation of the seven-point action plan has been challenging. Some of the points on the action plan, for example the fully implemented segmentation of all Secretariat voice and data networks globally, required enterprise programmes of work and change management actions involving technical teams located in all entities. Other steps, such as the creation and management of a repository of websites and applications to ensure the completeness and accuracy of records, involved detailed verification of self-assessments against key security policies. The remaining outstanding items include the migration of legacy and unsupported systems to standard platforms, which requires financial investment and thus leads to implementation over multiple periods, which results in some delays.
